fields.title: Retry visibly reports checking and an unavailable folder
fields.description: The single Retry works and logs one null root result, but its unchanged UI leaves the reader unsure anything happened. FOLDER-NOTICE-2 is dissolved and is not reopened.
fields.notes: Owner smoke intake 2026-10-26. Proposed priority P2. Sources F16. Acceptance/evidence: docs/planning/roadmap-reviews/2026-10-26-smoke-triage.md. Stub; investigation/specification required. Release hold unchanged.
fields.deliverable: Show an accessible checking state and a clear unavailable result after failure; successful retry clears the banner. Preserve single-click/single-request behavior and no repeated toast loop.
